New Fishing Rule in Effect 

To ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all, the Board has adopted a revised fishing rule for Hunter’s Creek.

Fishing is now permitted only in designated areas.
 Fishing behind private homes or within 100 feet of fountains, aerators, or flow control structures is prohibited.
 All anglers are expected to practice catch and release, properly dispose of trash, and respect our community’s water systems and wildlife.

View the full rule and fishing map here. If you have any questions, please contact Town Hall at general@hunterscreek.net.
